caption: The drawing features a detailed, shaded representation of a cylindrical metal mug with a handle on the left side. The mug is rendered in grayscale using fine lines and shading to convey its metallic texture and reflective surface. Above the mug, there is an ornate, intertwined monogram composed of the letters "S" and "R". Below and to the left of the mug, the name "HANS WESTENDORF" is written in all capital, spaced letters. The matted background of the drawing is a uniform light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Silver Mug
